instruction: Candid studio photograph, full shot. Indoors, a girl in a maroon t-shirt and white pants (R2) on the left and a boy in a red beanie and white t-shirt (R1) on the right stand on a light gray sofa. Together, they hold a large Canadian flag open between them, smiling joyfully at each other. The background is a minimalist beige wall. The lighting is soft and warm, casting gentle shadows and emphasizing the bright red of the flag and the boy's beanie.
